description: Open a standing concern (affair) for this conversation: something to keep watching across days, with periodic reviews. Asynchronous: it records the concern and returns; reviews happen later.

manage.description: What to watch and what matters about it, e.g. 'Watch for Kill Tony tickets in Austin to become available; the user wants to buy one.'

review_in.description: When to first review the concern, as a duration like "1d", "6h", or "30m". Omit for a concern reviewed only on demand.
